query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='matrix-org/synapse' AND number=2212 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body: I've had reports that when the IRC bridge kicks a user and the user subsequently rejoins the room, they have zero history whatsoever. They should have had history up until the point they were kicked. Details in linked issues.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body:
Okay, so the history bug is something that needs to be taken up with Synapse (https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212), not the IRC bridge.

Those errors *only* happen if you are not identified with the IRC network, the bridge doesn't do any reggednick checks itself.

data.body: @grahamperrin I'm afraid I don't understand what those screenshots are meant to show me. Are you saying that the IRC bridge is kicking you from a particular room? That would be a matter for the IRC bridge, not Synapse.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body: In terms of whether history is visible after you are kicked from and then rejoin a room - I would expect that to work ok, but it's certainly possible there is a bug there. I can't see it would be specific to IRC-bridged rooms, though.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body:
@richvdh what more information do you need for this issue?

Yes this is not an issue specific to irc-bridged rooms, I asked in the irc-bridge chat and someone confirmed the same problem in an room unrelated to the bridge.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body:
https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-829129114

> … what those screenshots are meant to show …

Sorry. In retrospect, I see that there's insufficient detail at the foot of the second shot. 

Re: https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-appservice-irc/wiki/End-user-FAQ#i-am-getting-kicked-out-of-a-bridged-room-with-the--err_needreggednick-error I got: 

`err_needreggednick`

– and re: the third shot, I assume that this was a consequence of a server being offline at some point. 

Through no fault of mine: all history disappeared, and did not reappear after I reidentified.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body:
> Through no fault of mine: all history disappeared, and did not reappear after I reidentified 

to be clear: history visibility in Matrix is unrelated to IRC nick registration (though identifying with the nickserv *is* necessary to stop you being kicked from IRC channels which require that, of course).

> Yes this is not an issue specific to irc-bridged rooms, I asked in the irc-bridge chat and someone confirmed the same problem in an room unrelated to the bridge.

I have been unable to reproduce this in testing. I have tried leaving a room and rejoining, and being kicked from a room and rejoining. In both cases my client was able to retrieve history from the room.

I've gone digging in the `matrix.org` logs and database to see if I can see what happened to @grahamperrin on 25th April. I see the kicks and rejoins:

```
      to_timestamp      |              event_id              |           sender           |        state_key         |                                                   content                                                    
------------------------+------------------------------------+----------------------------+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2021-04-25 20:58:41+01 | $16193807215874406imsbM:matrix.org | @grahamperrin:matrix.org   | @grahamperrin:matrix.org | {"avatar_url":"mxc://matrix.org/cooObxhGLEeJhcIlyPPaUDiw","displayname":"Graham Perrin","membership":"join"}
 2021-04-25 20:46:25+01 | $16193799851356577HdifR:matrix.org | @appservice-irc:matrix.org | @grahamperrin:matrix.org | {"membership":"leave","reason":"IRC error on #freebsd: err_needreggednick"}
 2021-04-25 20:46:24+01 | $16193799845863170Waxlt:matrix.org | @grahamperrin:matrix.org   | @grahamperrin:matrix.org | {"avatar_url":"mxc://matrix.org/cooObxhGLEeJhcIlyPPaUDiw","displayname":"Graham Perrin","membership":"join"}
 2021-04-24 23:01:35+01 | $16193016951076927xLyxk:matrix.org | @appservice-irc:matrix.org | @grahamperrin:matrix.org | {"membership":"leave","reason":"IRC error on #freebsd: err_needreggednick"}
```

... but I *don't* see any attempt by a client to retrieve history for that room around that time.

This leads me to suspect a client-side bug.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body:
It doesn't always happen after a kick. When it happened to me I had the problem on both Element Android and Mirage. On the next few times I didn't have the problem.

Note that the channel also didn't show in the roster when the problem happened until I rejoined it, then after I rejoined it would show history from before until I did a search.

data.body:
Of course, it helps if you grep for the right thing. Here are the history requests @grahamperrin's client sent after he rejoined:

```
2021-04-25 19:58:43,304 - synapse.access.http.8146 - 393 - INFO - GET-3532826 - 88.105.96.80 - 8146 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 0.141sec/-0.000sec (0.050sec, 0.001sec) (0.005sec/0.087sec/9) 218B 200 "GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259814-1971203433_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0" [21 dbevts]
2021-04-25 19:58:43,502 - synapse.access.http.8148 - 393 - INFO - GET-3534413 - 88.105.96.80 - 8148 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 0.111sec/-0.000sec (0.037sec, 0.010sec) (0.002sec/0.082sec/8) 218B 200 "GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259794-1971188387_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0" [1 dbevts]
2021-04-25 19:58:43,902 - synapse.access.http.8149 - 393 - INFO - GET-3534808 - 88.105.96.80 - 8149 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 0.143sec/-0.000sec (0.055sec, 0.008sec) (0.004sec/0.083sec/10) 218B 200 "GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259774-1971181568_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0" [21 dbevts]
2021-04-25 19:58:44,163 - synapse.access.http.8111 - 393 - INFO - GET-3520103 - 88.105.96.80 - 8111 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 0.169sec/-0.000sec (0.056sec, 0.011sec) (0.010sec/0.101sec/10) 218B 200 "GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259754-1971173976_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0" [21 dbevts]
2021-04-25 19:58:46,584 - synapse.access.http.8090 - 393 - INFO - GET-3524648 - 88.105.96.80 - 8090 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 2.345sec/-0.000sec (0.052sec, 0.004sec) (0.032sec/0.188sec/8) 218B 200 "GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259734-1971170676_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0" [21 dbevts]
```

There are several backfill requests there, all of which look to be returning empty results.

It looks like what's going on here is that Synapse is working its way through the 1053 events in the room between @grahamperrin's kick on 24th April and his rejoin on 25th April that he is not allowed to see (so returning an empty resultset). What is not clear to me is why element decides to stop paginating - it should continue to send requests until it hits visible events, or you switch to a different room.

The best thing I can suggest right now is to report a bug in the client. For element-web, attaching the debug logs next time it happens will likely help the developers.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body: That still doesn't explain why sometimes the room is not in the client roster. I suspect that in one case of this bug for some reason such a room is not included in the response for the clients initial sync. Not seeing the room in the roster happened to me on https://matrix.to/#/#irc:matrix.org which has history_visibility:shared, so that didn't result in a history problem. But I suspect on rooms that have it set to joined the reason that the client has not seen it in sync results in the client not requesting enough history.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body:
@JanZerebecki by "client roster" you mean the room list in the client?

If the room is visible in the client at all (even with no history) then that suggests the room is in the /sync response. If it's not there... maybe you're not in the room? Either way, it sounds like a separate problem to me and I encourage you to file a separate bug clearly detailing what happened. (From your description: you were kicked, you rejoined (how?), the room was missing from the room list?, you rejoined *again*? (how?))

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body:
OW. I missed that sync doesn't include historical rooms unless you add a include_leave filter. Yes, I meant the room list. I can't find element android making use of include_leave, even though the android sdk has functionality for it, seems https://github.com/vector-im/element-android/issues/49 is the issue for that missing feature. Mirage doesn't support it either.

Thx. I can now see how this might be a client bug.

data.title: History visibility = joined fails on kicks
data.body: We agree that this is most likely a client bug, thank you for reporting it :)
